title: Cross-functional roadmap sync prep — Oct 2026 (Lina notes)
content:
Notes to self for cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML)
Date: Oct 4 2026 (weekly roadmap sync)
Attendees to ping: Maya (PM), Raj (Eng lead), Dylan (Applied ML), Asha (SRE - optional), Tom (Console PM)

Goal of this sync:
- Surface major cross-team dependencies for Q4 workstreams and make yes/no decisions on blockers.
- Align on rollout sequencing for: model-variants routing, kv-cache rollout, and staged quantization profiles.
- Confirm metrics we’ll track during canary and post-rollout (latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, quality eval deltas).

Context / background (short):
- Product wants to ship model variant routing (policy-based routing) in mid Oct to enable cost-tier fallbacks. PM plan: feature flagged rollout + console UI.
- Serving runtime team needs final testing for KV cache eviction heuristics (perf variance seen on long-history chats).
- Applied ML has candidate quantization config (4-bit QK) that reduces cost ~35% but shows small nudge on chat-quality on 2 prompt templates. Need an eval plan.

Agenda draft (30-40m):
1) Quick status round (5m) - each lead: green/yellow/red and 1 blocking ask
2) Routing rollout plan review (10m) - Product/Eng: sequence + feature flag gating + telemetry hooks
3) KV cache eviction heuristics (10m) - Eng: perf numbers, suggested thresholds, SRE risk
4) Quantization canary plan (10m) - Applied ML: eval sets, rollback criteria, sample size
5) Open dependencies & action owner readout (5m)

Key questions I want answered during meeting (priority):
- Can Eng guarantee a fallback to non-quantized variant without user-visible errors? (Raj)
- What exact telemetry events will Product need in console to validate rollback decisions? (Maya)
- What is acceptable quality delta for quantization (applied-ml suggestion: <1.5% on eval set top-level metric)? Agree?
- Timeline for infra rollout windows (SRE maintenance windows or blackouts)?

Unresolved risks / things to surface:
- Serving runtime observed 8–12% P95 latency spike in internal perf tests when KV cache configured with large TTL + high-concurrency. Might affect enterprise customers on Dedicated pools. Need root cause review timeline.
- Model routing requires fast-mapping table in control plane (latency hotspot) — if we do per-request lookups in control plane could add ~3–5ms. Need caching plan in SDK/edge.
- Quantization regressions currently measured on two prompt templates — need broader prompt coverage (CS + PD team to contribute 10 more templates).

Suggested telemetry/metrics to confirm in canary (concrete):
- latency_p50, latency_p95 (per-model, per-region)
- tokens_generated_per_second and tokens_cost (cost per 1k tokens)
- quality_eval_delta_{promptset_name} (applied-ml eval name) — track confidence intervals
- error_rate (5xxs + timeout) and fallback_count (how often route falls back to variant)

Action items (capture in meeting + assign):
- Raj: run isolation perf tests for KV eviction heuristics with Dedicated-like load by Oct 8; upload perf deck to PR (#842) and add notes. (deadline: 2026-10-08)
- Maya: finalize console telemetry event list and required dashboards; draft console rollout UX for routing flags by Oct 6. (deadline: 2026-10-06)
- Dylan: expand quantization eval set with 10 additional templates (CS + PD inputs), run A/B eval and produce summary with CI by Oct 9. Set rollback threshold. (deadline: 2026-10-09)
- Lina (me): coordinate with SRE to book maintenance window options and prepare canary checklist; share checklist by Oct 5. (deadline: 2026-10-05)
- Asha: validate fallback path end-to-end (integration test) and add a smoke test to CI that runs on PRs touching routing/runtime. (deadline: 2026-10-07)

Notes to self (things to say / avoid in sync):
- Emphasize conservative canary — prefer slower rollout + clear telemetry over rushing for mid-Oct.
- Ask Product to own user-facing messaging for any perceived quality delta.
- Avoid technical deep dives in weekly sync; if Raj wants more time, schedule a separate infra deep-dive.

Short-term timeline (high level):
- Oct 4: roadmap sync (this meeting) — lock on sequencing, owners, telemetry list
- Oct 5–9: engineering + applied-ml run canary tests + telemetry dashboards created
- Oct 10–12: small canary (1% traffic) + monitor 72h -> if green, ramp to 10% -> 100% per rollout policy

Possible blockers to raise early:
- If isolation perf tests show unexpected P95 spikes, need an SRE-led emergency triage slot — plan to escalate to weekly SRE/infra war room.
- If applied-ml finds >2% quality delta on expanded eval, we delay quantization by one sprint and widen rollout plan.

Follow-ups after meeting (what I will do):
- Update Confluence page with agreed telemetry and action items (link back to JIRA tickets).
- Create single tracking ticket that aggregates RDW-1234 (routing) + RDW-1301 (kv cache) + RDW-1310 (quantization canary) for exec visibility.
- Ping CS for two high-priority prompt templates to add to evaluation set.

Loose notes / scratch ideas:
- Could we expose a per-customer routing override in console for enterprise customers? Might be a break-glass path for quality incidents. Needs legal review? (maybe product asks sales)
- Consider adding a "quality smoke" synthetic user journey that runs the 3 highest-risk prompts every 10 minutes against canary buckets. Cheap but high signal.

End of notes.
